name: pdf-toolkit
description: Open any PDF already on your computer and work with it: read, fill, extract, merge, split, and compare locally. Optional Lumin signing sends a prepared PDF and recipient details only after explicit confirmation.
long_description:
PDF Tools turns Claude Desktop into a complete PDF workstation with local file operations. Claude can fetch PDFs from URLs, inspect them visually, fill forms, manage pages, add signature/date zones, apply local signatures or text, extract structured data, and return document content to the selected MCP host for analysis.

This package targets Claude Desktop and other local MCP hosts today. It does not yet include a remote Claude/Cowork connector.

**Interactive PDF Viewer:**
• View PDFs with page navigation, zoom, search, text selection, and fullscreen
• See form fields in a sidebar with fill status
• Use visual page management to reorder, rotate, and remove pages before saving
• Switch into Sign mode to work with signature/date zones on the PDF

**Sign Mode & Local Signatures:**
• Detect signature, initials, printed-name, and date zones with visible coordinates Claude can reason from
• Draw or reuse saved local signatures
• Place signatures, dates, or other text on detected or custom zones
• Inspect a region, preview it, and turn it into a typed signing zone when the automatic detector is not enough
• Keep edits local, with active-document tracking and automatic backup behavior for same-file mutations
• Optionally send an exact prepared PDF and listed recipient details to Lumin only after explicit confirmation

**URL-to-PDF Workflows:**
• Fetch PDFs from HTTP(S) URLs to the user's local machine, including cases where Claude's WebFetch is blocked
• Open downloaded PDFs immediately in the viewer for fill, sign, page management, extraction, or analysis
• Use page-bounded reads, text search, page renders, and region renders instead of one brittle all-document operation

**Forms & Reusable Profiles:**
• Fill W-9s, 1099s, rental applications, waivers, and any fillable PDF
• Save personal or business details as reusable profiles
• List, load, and apply saved profiles so repeated forms take seconds instead of minutes
• Bulk fill many PDFs from CSV data and validate required fields before submission

**Page Organization Tools:**
• Merge multiple PDFs into one document
• Split PDFs by exact page ranges or regular intervals
• Rotate and reorder pages, or apply a full page plan in one pass
• Keep the original intact by saving organized output as a new file

**Extraction, Rendering & Analysis:**
• Read existing PDF text layers for summarization, question answering, and research workflows
• Read specific page ranges and search PDF text with page-numbered snippets
• Convert supported born-digital page ranges to deterministic Markdown with explicit coverage gaps
• Render full pages or bounded regions to PNG for host/model vision on scanned or image-heavy documents
• If a selected `read_pdf_content` extraction has no text, return a rendered image of page 1 when available
• Keep rendering and text recognition distinct: page and region renders are raster images, not OCR text
• Treat mixed text/raster documents and raster pages after page 1 as potentially unrecognized by broad text reads
• Extract structured data to CSV
• Inspect page-level details like orientation, text presence, images, and likely blank pages
• Review metadata such as page count, dimensions, form fields, and file size

**Local file operations and host-aware privacy:** PDF Tools reads, renders, edits, and saves files on the user's machine. It does not upload PDFs to a separate PDF service unless the user explicitly confirms the optional Lumin signing workflow. Text, images, or metadata returned through MCP may be processed under the selected host or model provider's data terms. Claude Desktop users choose which folders PDF Tools may read from or write to.

**Works with many PDF types:** Forms, contracts, research papers, technical manuals, invoices, financial statements, scanned documents, municipal packets, and encrypted PDFs. The local runtime does not currently bundle OCR; optional local OCR remains planned rather than shipped.

**Best for:** People who need more than a viewer: operators processing forms, lawyers organizing contracts, accountants handling tax documents, researchers reviewing papers, and anyone who wants local PDF file operations with their chosen MCP host.

tools.name: display_pdf
tools.description: Display an interactive PDF viewer with search, navigation, zoom, and form field detection

tools.name: list_pdfs
tools.description: List PDF files in a directory, sorted by name, up to 200 per call

tools.name: read_pdf_fields
tools.description: Read all form fields from a PDF file

tools.name: fill_pdf
tools.description: Fill a PDF form; may save in place with automatic backup

tools.name: bulk_fill_from_csv
tools.description: Fill multiple PDFs using data from a CSV file

tools.name: save_profile
tools.description: Save form data as a reusable profile

tools.name: load_profile
tools.description: Load a saved profile

tools.name: list_profiles
tools.description: List all saved profiles

tools.name: fill_with_profile
tools.description: Fill a PDF using a saved profile

tools.name: extract_to_csv
tools.description: Extract form data from filled PDFs to a CSV file

tools.name: validate_pdf
tools.description: Inspect AcroForm value coverage and actual PDF Required flags without claiming the form is ready to submit

tools.name: read_pdf_content
tools.description: Read PDF content with explicit complete, partial, or failed extraction status

tools.name: read_pdf_pages
tools.description: Read a bounded page range from a PDF with page-numbered structured output

tools.name: read_pdf_layout
tools.description: Extract bounded local text geometry and conservative reading order into the versioned PDF Tools Extraction IR

tools.name: convert_pdf_to_markdown
tools.description: Convert supported local PDF text to deterministic Markdown with explicit partial and unsupported-content gaps, including evidence-backed tables and source-validated external http or https links; optionally enable counted compact-mode normalizations

tools.name: verify_table_proposal
tools.description: Check a suggested table against the original PDF and return it only when the text and layout match the document; unclear tables stay unconverted for review

tools.name: render_pdf_page
tools.description: Render one source-bound PDF.js page view to PNG with distinct raw page geometry, view geometry, renderer policy, and digest evidence

tools.name: render_pdf_region
tools.description: Render a bounded source-bound PDF.js viewport region to PNG; these coordinates are not MediaBox-relative signing coordinates

tools.name: search_pdf_text
tools.description: Search extracted PDF text for a phrase and return page-numbered snippets

tools.name: get_pdf_resource_uri
tools.description: Get a resource URI for a PDF file that can be used with Claude's built-in PDF reading capabilities via the Resources API

tools.name: get_pdf_identity
tools.description: Get a parser-independent canonical path, exact byte length, and SHA-256 for a local PDF up to 250 MiB after validating its PDF header

tools.name: merge_pdfs
tools.description: Merge multiple PDF files into a single PDF

tools.name: split_pdf
tools.description: Split a PDF into multiple files by page ranges or intervals

tools.name: rotate_pdf_pages
tools.description: Rotate pages in a PDF by 90, 180, or 270 degrees

tools.name: reorder_pdf_pages
tools.description: Rearrange the pages of a PDF in a new order

tools.name: inspect_pdf_accessibility
tools.description: Inspect eight shallow catalog-level accessibility signals with source binding, fixed limitations, and required human review

tools.name: compare_pdfs
tools.description: Deterministically compare two whole local PDFs with source-bound semantic, text, structure, form, annotation, metadata, and optional visual evidence

tools.name: get_pdf_info
tools.description: Observe bounded source-bound PDF page geometry, metadata, form widgets, and inert ordinary annotations with explicit coverage

tools.name: apply_page_plan
tools.description: Reorder, rotate, and delete PDF pages in one pass, saving as a new file

tools.name: get_page_analysis
tools.description: Analyze PDF pages with provenance-safe blank, unknown, orientation, text, and image status

tools.name: fetch_pdf_from_url
tools.description: Download a PDF from an HTTP(S) URL to the user's local machine. Works when Claude's WebFetch is blocked

tools.name: create_signature
tools.description: Save a reusable typed-name or image signature to ~/.pdf-toolkit-files/signatures/

tools.name: get_allowed_directories
tools.description: Report which folders this server may read and write, which configuration layer supplied them, and where the stored configuration file lives

tools.name: list_signatures
tools.description: List all saved signatures

tools.name: load_signature
tools.description: Load one saved signature by name, including preview data for image signatures

tools.name: get_active_document
tools.description: Return the toolkit's current canonical PDF path, backup path, and last mutation metadata

tools.name: set_active_document
tools.description: Rehydrate the toolkit's active document state from the currently open viewer session

tools.name: add_signature_field
tools.description: Draw a visible 'Sign here' placeholder box on a PDF page (marks location only; does NOT sign)

tools.name: apply_signature
tools.description: Stamp a saved signature at a specific location. Requires explicit human intent (user_intent_statement + user_confirmed_at). Basic local stamp, not cryptographic signing.

tools.name: prepare_signing_packet
tools.description: Fill form fields AND add sign-here placeholder boxes in one pass, returning a pending-signatures manifest

tools.name: start_lumin_authorization
tools.description: Connect a Lumin account securely

tools.name: finish_lumin_authorization
tools.description: Finish connecting a Lumin account

tools.name: prepare_lumin_request
tools.description: Preview a Lumin signing request locally

tools.name: send_lumin_request
tools.description: Send a confirmed signing request to Lumin

tools.name: check_lumin_status
tools.description: Check an existing Lumin signing request

tools.name: download_lumin_artifact
tools.description: Download a completed Lumin signing artifact

tools.name: detect_signature_zones
tools.description: Find places in a PDF for signatures, initials, printed names, and dates. Use apply_signature for signatures and initials, and apply_text for names and dates. Never guess coordinates.

tools.name: apply_text
tools.description: Stamp a plain text string at a location (for date zones or arbitrary text fills; no intent required)

tools.name: create_extraction_workspace
tools.description: Create a private local workspace bound to exact PDF and JSON Schema bytes

tools.name: inspect_extraction_state
tools.description: Inspect the exact current generation and recovery state of a verified extraction workspace

tools.name: read_extraction_workspace
tools.description: Read bounded pages of chunks, pending leaves, proposals, results, or events

tools.name: read_extraction_chunk
tools.description: Rebuild one source-bound chunk from fresh local PDF bytes

tools.name: submit_extraction_proposal
tools.description: Append one explicitly unverified schema-leaf proposal bound to source chunks

tools.name: verify_extraction_proposal
tools.description: Deterministically replay and retain one cited extraction proposal without a model or network

tools.name: delete_extraction_workspace
tools.description: Delete a private extraction workspace only under exact identity and generation bindings

tools.name: reveal_in_finder
tools.description: Open the OS file manager with the given file selected. Used by the viewer to surface the active PDF or its backup

prompts.name: view_and_analyze_pdf
prompts.description: Open and analyze any PDF document
prompts.text: Use PDF Tools to open a PDF stored on this computer and analyze it, focusing on ${arguments.focus}. If I haven't given you a path, start by listing the PDFs in my default folder so I can pick one. Then extract key findings, summarize sections, answer questions about specific pages, pull out structured data, and identify form fields if present.

prompts.name: research_paper_analysis
prompts.text: Use PDF Tools to analyze a research paper stored on this computer, focusing on ${arguments.focus_area}. If I haven't given you a path, start by listing the PDFs in my default folder so I can pick one. Extract the key findings and methodology, identify research gaps, summarize it chapter by chapter, pull out the citations, and draft a literature review outline.

prompts.name: contract_comparison
prompts.text: Use PDF Tools to compare contracts or legal documents stored on this computer, focusing on ${arguments.comparison_focus}. If I haven't given you their paths, start by listing the PDFs in my default folder so I can pick them. Highlight changed clauses, modified terms, added or removed sections, pricing differences, and liability changes, then summarize the comparison.

prompts.name: financial_report_extraction
prompts.text: Use PDF Tools to extract and analyze data from financial PDFs stored on this computer, including tables and key metrics. If I haven't given you a path, start by listing the PDFs in my default folder so I can pick one. Convert what you extract to ${arguments.output_format} format, cite the page for the values you extract, and tell me plainly about anything you could not extract.

prompts.name: document_qa_session
prompts.text: Use PDF Tools to open a PDF stored on this computer so we can discuss it. My first question is: ${arguments.initial_question}. If I haven't given you a path, start by listing the PDFs in my default folder so I can pick one. Find specific information, explain complex sections, cross-reference different parts, and quote passages with their page numbers.

prompts.name: bulk_invoice_processing
prompts.description: Process multiple invoices into structured data
prompts.text: Use PDF Tools to process the invoice PDFs in the folder ${arguments.folder_path} on this computer and build a unified dataset in ${arguments.output_format} format. Start by listing the PDFs in that folder so I can see what you found. Extract vendor names, invoice numbers, dates, line items, totals, tax amounts, and payment terms, and tell me about any invoice you could not read.

prompts.name: technical_documentation_summary
prompts.text: Use PDF Tools to analyze technical documentation stored on this computer and create ${arguments.summary_type}. If I haven't given you a path, start by listing the PDFs in my default folder so I can pick one. Extract the code examples, build a reference guide, identify the implementation steps, and summarize the troubleshooting sections.

prompts.name: fill_w9_business
prompts.text: Use PDF Tools to fill out a W-9 stored on this computer for my business. If I haven't already given you the file, start by listing the PDFs in my default folder so I can point you at the right form, then read its fields. Ask me for the business legal name, the DBA or trade name if it differs, the business type (LLC, corporation, partnership), the tax classification, the EIN, and the business address. Check the correct tax classification boxes and tell me about any required field you could not fill.

prompts.name: batch_invoices
prompts.text: Use PDF Tools to batch process invoice PDFs stored on this computer. If I haven't already named them, start by listing the PDFs in my default folder so I can confirm which ones to use, or I'll name the folder they are in. Extract the amounts and dates, build a summary spreadsheet, flag missing information, total them by vendor, date, and category, and tell me about any invoice you could not read. Ask me which fields matter most before you start.

prompts.name: rental_application
prompts.text: Use PDF Tools to help me complete a rental application stored on this computer. If I haven't already given you the file, start by listing the PDFs in my default folder so I can point you at the right form, then read its fields. I'll have ready my personal details, three years of employment history, income verification, three years of previous addresses, references, vehicle information, and an emergency contact. Fill every required field and flag the ones that need supporting documents.

prompts.name: extract_1099_data
prompts.text: Use PDF Tools to extract the data from 1099 forms stored on this computer (1099-NEC, 1099-MISC, 1099-DIV, 1099-INT and similar) and build a tax summary. If I haven't already named them, start by listing the PDFs in my default folder so I can confirm which ones to use. Organize by payer, identify the type of income, total each category, format it for import into tax software, and tell me about anything you could not read.

prompts.name: merge_documents
prompts.description: Combine multiple PDFs into one document
prompts.text: Use PDF Tools to merge PDF files stored on this computer into one document. If I haven't already named them, start by listing the PDFs in my default folder so I can choose which ones to combine, then ask me where to save the result. Preserve the page order, and afterwards report the page count and the output path so I can check it. File operations happen locally; content you inspect is handled under my MCP host or model provider's data terms.

prompts.name: split_large_document
prompts.description: Split a PDF into smaller files
prompts.text: Use PDF Tools to split a PDF stored on this computer into separate files. If I haven't given you a path, start by listing the PDFs in my default folder so I can pick one. I'll either give you exact page ranges (for example pages 1-10 and 11-20) or ask you to split at a regular interval (for example every 5 pages). Save each section as its own PDF and tell me where you wrote them.

prompts.name: organize_scanned_pages
prompts.description: Rotate and reorder scanned PDF pages
prompts.text: Use PDF Tools to fix up a scanned PDF stored on this computer. If I haven't given you a path, start by listing the PDFs in my default folder so I can pick one. Rotate the pages I tell you are sideways or upside-down (90, 180, or 270 degrees) and reorder pages that were scanned out of sequence. Tell me the page order and rotations you plan to apply before you save, so I can confirm them.

lumin_oauth_client_id.title: Lumin OAuth Client ID
lumin_oauth_client_id.description: Public client ID for an OAuth app registered with the exact redirect URI http://127.0.0.1/callback. This is an application identifier, not a client secret.

download_directory.title: Download Directory
download_directory.description: Where PDFs saved via fetch_pdf_from_url land by default. You can still override per-call with the destination_dir argument, but this is the default for new downloads.

default_pdf_directory.title: Default PDFs Folder
default_pdf_directory.description: Where list_pdfs looks when no directory is specified.

allowed_directories.title: Allowed PDF Directories
allowed_directories.description: Folders this extension may read from or write to. PDF tools will refuse paths outside these folders. Profiles and saved signatures remain in the extension's private local store.
